_comment: Purpose: archived organiser-supplied OAC milestones. The Home timeline has been removed at the user’s request; this text is retained for possible future story content and is not fetched by the website.

items.title: Our anime family begins
items.description: A small group of friends founded OAC in Bhubaneswar, tired of watching anime alone. Casual meet-ups brought a few dozen fans, a borrowed screen and debates over the best opening. Group chats and Instagram helped the family grow.

items.title: Five years of OAC · 100+ members
items.description: Our fifth anniversary brought more than 100 members together for cake-cutting, a five-years-of-OAC photo wall and a fiercely contested quiz tie-breaker. For many, it was their first time seeing the whole community in one room.

items.title: Naruto movie meet-up · 100+ fans
items.description: Over 100 fans came together with headbands, hand signs and loud cheers at every big moment.

items.title: Demon Slayer movie meet-up · 100+ fans
items.description: More than 100 fans joined a movie meet-up filled with Corps uniforms, haori and emotional moments shared together.

items.title: Weeb La Khai · 30–40 people
items.description: A relaxed gathering built around games, fan-art sharing and plenty of snacks. Members still remember it as one of the community’s friendliest days.

items.title: Ichigo · more than 410 people
items.description: OAC’s largest turnout to date brought cosplayers, artists, gamers and first-timers together. The day showed that Odisha’s anime scene could fill a hall.

items.title: Jujutsu Kaisen movie meet-up · 100+ fans
items.description: More than 100 fans gathered with cursed-energy-themed photo spots and plenty of Gojo cosplayers.

items.title: Solo Leveling meet-up · 30–40 fans
items.description: A level-up-themed evening with trivia, a fan-art wall and a rank-based mini game that had everyone hunting for an S-rank title.

items.title: Spirited Away watch party · 100+ attendees
items.description: A calmer, cosier evening shared by more than 100 attendees. Many left saying it felt like a community hug.
